_schema.description: Single source of truth for image-generation model IDs and their capabilities. No model ID literal may appear anywhere else in this skill's instructions (SKILL.md, presets/, reference/) — always resolve through this file. Analogous in principle (not storage mechanism) to n3ural-platform's api.model_registry / lib/agent/model-registry.ts (spec 017): same data-driven, no-hardcoding intent, deliberately translated from a DB table to a flat JSON file because this skill has no persistent runtime/DB of its own.

fields.id: Canonical model identifier used as the registry lookup key. Never write this string literally in SKILL.md or presets/ — always reference it as e.g. `registry.profiles.hero.model_id`.
fields.provider: Structured object identifying the routing provider. Kept as an object (not a bare string) specifically so a second provider can be added as a sibling entry later without any change to skill logic or SKILL.md instructions (FR-004). `name` is a stable provider key; `path` distinguishes the two invocation routes this skill supports for the same underlying model.
fields.requesty_model: The exact model string to send to Requesty's OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint (primary path). null for entries that are not routed to (e.g. the retired reference entry).
fields.vertex_model: The direct-Vertex-AI equivalent model resource path, used only by the Vertex-direct fallback path (region europe-west3, Service Account/ADC auth) when Requesty is unavailable. null for entries that are not routed to.
fields.profiles: Which of the three skill profiles (draft, hero, photoreal) resolve to this model entry. Empty array = not routed to by any active profile (reference-only entry).
fields.capabilities: Object describing supported aspect_ratios and resolution_tiers for this model, used to validate image_config requests before they are sent.
fields.default_resolution: The resolution tier a profile falls back to when the invoking agent does not specify one explicitly. Present only on entries that serve as a profile default (draft).
fields.retirement_date: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null. SKILL.md instructs the agent to compare this against the current date on every registry load and warn if a model is within 30 days of retirement or already past it (instruction-level check, no automated tooling).
fields.status: active | retired-reference. retired-reference entries exist for audit/documentation purposes only and MUST NOT be routed to by any profile — profiles array MUST be empty for these.
fields.note: Free-text human-readable annotation, e.g. explaining why a retired-reference entry is kept.

entries.note: Draft profile default — fast, cheap composition exploration (10-20 variants). @1K unless the agent explicitly requests otherwise for a draft run.
Shared by hero and photoreal profiles. photoreal applies presets/photoreal.md on top of the same model/config — no separate model entry needed per FR-005.

Reference-only entry (FR-003). Retires 2026-10-02. Not routed to by any active profile in this skill — do not use. Also referenced (out of scope for this skill) in the Niimo repo's imagenClient.ts / generateRecipeImage.ts / imageStyle.ts / tokenTracker.ts and ADR-042; that migration is tracked on the Niimo roadmap, not here.

draft.description: Fast, cheap composition exploration — 10-20 variants at 1K before a final asset is committed to.

hero.description: Final production-ready asset at 2K or 4K, 16:9 or 21:9.

photoreal.description: Same model and config surface as hero, with the photorealism prompt preset applied on top.
